heading.text: 继续编辑已保存的草稿

guidance.source: Open a private-evidence-draft.json file previously downloaded from this editor. Preview it before restoring. The saved paper selection is used only in this tab; your saved bibliography stays unchanged.
guidance.text: 打开此前从此编辑器下载的 private-evidence-draft.json 文件。请先预览，再恢复。文件中的论文选择仅用于当前标签页；已保存的文献库保持不变。

reading.source: Opening the backup in this tab…
reading.text: 正在当前标签页中打开备份…

summary.source: {papers} included papers · {reports} reports · {excerpts} retained excerpts · {claims} claims · {themes} themes
summary.text: {papers} 篇已选论文 · {reports} 份报告 · {excerpts} 段留存摘录 · {claims} 条论断 · {themes} 个主题

replace.source: Restoring replaces this tab’s current passage, imported reports, assessments and themes. Save your current draft first if you want to keep it.
replace.text: 恢复将替换当前标签页中的段落、已导入报告、评估和主题。如需保留当前草稿，请先保存。

restored.source: Draft restored in this tab. Continue editing, then download a new backup before leaving.
restored.text: 已在当前标签页中恢复草稿。请继续编辑，并在离开前下载新的备份。

refused.source: Backup not opened. Choose a valid Keryx private draft JSON file within the draft limits. Your current draft is unchanged.
refused.text: 未打开备份。请选择大小在草稿限制范围内的有效 Keryx 私密草稿 JSON 文件。当前草稿保持不变。

stale.source: This tab changed while the backup was being reviewed. Choose the file again to review it before replacing your latest edits.
stale.text: 预览备份期间，当前标签页的内容已发生变化。请重新选择文件并查看，然后再替换最新编辑内容。

cancelled.source: Restore cancelled. Your current draft is unchanged.
cancelled.text: 已取消恢复。当前草稿保持不变。
